notes.title: Roadmap + 7th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
7 Years of Wrath of the Goliaths

It’s hard to believe it’s already been seven years. Over that time, I’ve dreamed up countless ideas for this game, and I’m grateful to say that many of them have become reality. Today isn’t just another update; it’s a celebration. A celebration of dinosaurs, and of the game itself.

As we look ahead, I’m excited to share what’s coming in the next update. I hope you’ll look forward to it as much as I do.

Thank you, hunters, for being part of this journey.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/e98a7f60de40e4fb8f48279e7c2b8471ff209e12.jpg"]

With the major updates outlined, some minor updates include:

Reworked Main Menu

The Bones Shop to purchase licenses with bones

A new tutorial to get new hunters started! 

Also improved flyer AI, they will move with the terrain, avoiding impact with the ground and each other. 



It may be good to mention that among the handful of previous updates. Its worth mentioning, I made the switch to Unreal Engine 5 from Unreal Engine 4. It required a significant re-code for the menu and hunt systems. I also experimented with the various features Unreal Engine 5 has to offer. Many of these features were gorgeous, but significantly impacted performance. Some time was taken to undo many of those changes (Rollback and versioning software, who heard of 'em!).

Looking ahead, I want to shake it off and continue strong.  With that, here is a brief look at some of these updates, concept art, and more! 

-----------------------------------
Dimetrodon TLC: 

NEW: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/7da9ddf03218d9361e9c3cd29023bd7cf5f9c042.png"]OLD:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/dde4d604988cf354e5a5e31d371fb8bdb9a5c95d.jpg"]
This TLC was done by a collaboration with Feilong and Manuelsaurus.

-----------------------------------
IK and Locomotion update:Stegosaurus: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/8e166aa8482c15be332628fab8fae689bb2838f7.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/3ea6e1bc9dcf20351ffe6a711b7b7f7b6e03248f.gif"] 
-----------------------------------
Ancient Valley: 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/21f7cb6c05b196e37df9e7a39d2e7818a6851f10.jpg"]A refreshing new look for the starting map. Featuring updated lighting and reworked atmosphere and clouds for improved performance.  

----------------------------------- 
Eurodalosaurus concept art:
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/4bfc69cb8828c51629e46f8cabd5e5d6f193f75e.png"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30262415/3185327c12901e519e6587ca2ced91bbce3e8c3e.jpg"] 

These two pieces are only shown within the game-manual. Which will be revised once we leave early access. 

 ----------------------------------- 



All for now, but I hope you look forward to these updates. A bit longer with some major surprises still in store.  

As we celebrate this milestone, I want to take a moment to thank you, the players. What started as a silly passion-project turned game has grown into something far greater than I could have imagined. That’s entirely because of your support.

Every bit of encouragement, every piece of feedback, and every hour you’ve spent playing has helped me stay true to this project and keep moving forward. There were times when development was tough, but knowing that people believed in this game gave me the strength to continue.


From the bottom of my heart, thank you for being part of this journey.

To 7 years!

- Matthew

notes.title: Fall Devlog - Update Progress & Winter Sale
notes.notes:
Hey Hunters,

I apologize for the lack of updates and communication. I have been having to deal with major changes behind the scenes along with personal troubles and obligations. We are participating in the Steam Winter Sale! Grab Wrath of the Goliaths now untill January 2nd for 45% off!


Progress on the upcoming update is coming along, albeit way slower than expected. It is in fact such a major update though, I am expecting it to essentially put the game somewhere along the lines of Patch 0.5.x.0. I believe it will be that content intensive. Nearly pushing us to full release. Going forward, the third segment of the patch version will represent the date of the patch (MonthYear, ex. 120 representing January 2020).

As of now, here is a taste of the upcoming content:

Map Updates:
- Haystack Ridge revamp, increased FPS, and with new points of interest
- Dreary Sono revamp with new points of interest
- Flat Lands revamp with new points of interest
- New Map 1, it is an environment to get you familiar with your hunting skills
- New Map 2, a hostile environment to showcase the predators of Wrath of the Goliaths. This will be a very difficult map to hunt on. 
- All maps have revamped camera settings to look more true to life and less stylized. 
- All maps will have reduced grass


Hunt Updates:
- Several new dinosaurs:
Cryolophosaurus
Nigersaurus
Gigantospinosaurus (Smaller cousin of Stegosaurus)
And more!
- Several returning hunts:
T.Rex
Triceratops
Sauroposeidon
Dilophosaurus
Majungasaurus
- Dinosaur TLC:
T.Rex
Dimetrodon
Edaphosaurus
Megalosaurus
Stegosaurus
Sauroposeidon
Dilophosaurus
Majungasaurus
Carnotaurus
Apatosaurus
Acrocanthosaurus
Carcharodontosaurus

Dinosaur TLC is when the textures are remade to help enhance the detail on the dinosaurs. As well as retopology to help make animating and gameplay-integration more streamlined.


Gameplay Updates:
- New weapon:
The Flamethrower
- Trophy room
- Updated how trophies are collected and the information saved. This information is the distance from where you killed the dinosaur, and with what weapon killed the dinosaur
- Updated albino and melanistic skins
- New Alts for some dinosaurs
- Nests around the map, destroy the eggs and use them to lure in dinosaurs. For each successful nest destroyed, a reward is given. 
- Reduced inventory size
- It is less punishing for when you hunt illegal hunts
- Megalosaurus is nerfed
- Dinosaurs now have more accurate movement, resulting in slower speeds for some and increased speed for others
- 


Many more quality of life changes and bug fixes such as:
- Weapons no longer fire after you die
- You have to return to the base camp where you spawn in order to end the hunt
- Ragdoll fixes
- Grenade bounce issues
- Audio tweaks and changes such as replacing the foot step and landing audio
- Added death from falling, jumping off a cliff will result in your death. However, this has to be a substantial height, around the size of two T.Rex's


Thank you to all of you hunters! Here's a sneak peak of whats to come!

notes.title: Devlog - Summer Update Progress
notes.notes:
Hey hunters! 

The summer update is coming along well, here's just a bit of what is to come:

- Trophy Room
- Reworked Trophy save system, revamped to allow 20 dinosaurs to be bagged as well as more info such as weapon that killed the dinosaur and the distance the kill was taken down
- New Map with more dinosaurs being brought back in
- Dinosaur kill animations
- Reworked AI

Status on implementation:

- Trophy Room is about 50% of the way done (The design of the room itself is about 10%), with the code for it being about 90% (Just some polish on how the room saves)

- Reworked save system is done

- New Map and dinosaurs is about 45% done, map needs to be fleshed out more, dinosaurs have the new materials apply and new animations will be worked on or tweaked

- Dinosaur kill animations are about 10% done

- Reworked AI has yet to begin. I will be re-examining how the AI is done and make it more fun to hunt dinosaurs and add a level of uniqueness to each dinosaur. I know that has been one of the biggest complaints, and it was next on the check list after fixing frame-rate issues. 

When I fixed the frame rate issues, I did remake the entire game from scratch for the most part to ensure I nailed the bug down. It was hell, and unfortunately it left the game more bare bones than at launch. So I worked toward making the game more fleshed out with content, I realize that was a double-edged sword as now the content lacked any personality. 

This took a personal toll on me, as I received loads of criticism, and I thought I had no healthy way to express that I was a solo developer and this was my first outing. 

Moving forward, I want to make sure the content in the game appeases both fans of the great Carnivores series and fans of hunting games and dinosaurs. 


'Till next time hunters, have a preview of the final unlockable dinosaur! I don't have a name for the creature, and I would love to hear what you fans would want it to be named

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0.33
notes.notes:
How is it going hunters? A large update is finally here! 

Added: 
- HUD elements
- Arrow to guide you back when you're OOB
- NEW MAP "Dreary Sono", explore this large hunt area based on the beautiful deserts of Arizona.
- Parasaurolophus is now back in as a huntable dinosaur, with several updates to it's animations as well as a new unique crest frill-less variant. Watch out for this fast and skittish herbivore!
- Allosaurus is also back as a huntable dinosaur, smaller than it's more aggressive cousin, Saurophaganax, it still packs a mean bite.
- Introduction tutorial, this is a quick run-down to help new users get a started and learn the basics of the game. From what dinosaurs are available, their vulnerable spots, to what is and how to use Perma.
- Added flying reptiles, currently they are ambient hunts: Pteranodon, and Geosternbergia are currently able to be seen soaring the skies
- Loading screen spinner
- Added campsite objects (The camp is where you spawn in)


Fixes and tweaks:
- AI issues
- Tweaked dinosaur speeds
- Tweaked spawn rate
- Tweaked spawn zones
- Tweaked spawn amounts
- Tweaked weapon map spawns
- New spawn system. Bracketed into tiers, all areas will have a 'Trophy' hunt. These hunts are especially dangerous and large. Along with medium to small hunts, it is now easier to tell which hunt is available in each area. By selecting an area to hunt on, the hunt licenses will auto-update and refund any hunts that are unavailable, and will show the ones that are. 
- Tweaked weapon damage for the TR Shotgun
- Tweaked fire speed for some weapons
- Tweaked reload speed for some weapons
- Fixed audio issue, constant roar sounds should no longer be an issue. Roars have been fixed to now all be based on distance.
- Gunshots, running, and jumping are all actions that can scare hunts away or attract predators now.
- Shooting dinosaurs now will cause them to react and either chase you or run away.
- Perma values tweaked in the hunt shop
- Perma rewards tweaked 
- Perma rewards from "illegal hunts" now will exponentially decrease until it hits 0 from additional "illegal hunts"
- Loading screen fixed
- Tweaked the fog, lighting and post process settings in Haystack Ridge
- Fixed ambient animals not spawning with unique skins (I.e. Alternate, albino, melanistic skins)



Here are the list of hunts on each map:

Haystack Ridge:

- Saurophaganax - Trophy Hunt

- Stegosaurus

- Ceratosaurus

- Megalosaurus


Desert Map:

- Carcharodontosaurus - Trophy Hunt

- Allosaurus

- Parasaurolophus

- Stegosaurus


Looking forward:
Things we have planned that are underway:

- A brand new map, based on a swamp environment. 
- More dinosaurs to come back, and more to be added to existing maps. 
- A new dinosaur!
- Bug fixes
- AI changes
- New unique animations
- A new weapon
- Lore objectives
- Mission Mode

Since the day is almost over, and we had yet to have any fun. 
 We put a little special nod in for players looking for some nostalgic gameplay. Pressing 4 and 1, right after each other (Note that it may take a few attempts), you will enable a special mode!


 You can keep up to date with us on our Discord, we promise we are friendly.

https://discord.gg/sVST9g8

'Till next time hunters!

notes.title: Patch Status and Main Menu theme is on YouTube!
notes.notes:
The status on the upcoming patch 0.2.0.0:

We are excited to get this out as soon as we can. It isn't looking like too much longer is needed and we have many things to share that you can look forward to once the patch launches. 

Changes:
- New main menu UI
- New Hunt menu UI
- New logo for Wrath of the Goliaths: Dinosaurs
- New Hunter model, audio, and animations for first person and third person
- Updated in-game UI
- Added inventory system
- Updated the pause menu
- Reworked the trophy bagging system
- Added animation and interaction for when you bag the trophy
- Reworked the AI system
- Reworked the spawn system
- Proper game instance settings, removed the old hunt variable system. This should alleviate major problems with loading levels
- Fixed the weather system to properly load the selected weather
- Added Tupuxuara
- Added Pteranodon
- Updated the loading screen
- New weapon system is implemented, you can now drop weapons as they run out of ammunition, or pick up weapons you find while hunting
- The ui will now shame you if you hunt an animal you don't have a license for
- New map in the works, will replace both maps from former builds. We are sad to see them go as it did take a lot of effort to create them, but it is the only way we can be certain the game will run efficiently is to start from scratch.

notes.title: 0.1.1.1 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Patch 0.1.1.1 is now live!

Update Apatosaurus and the new Tyrannosaurus Rex now huntable 
Updated the spawn system, the selected hunts have an increased chance at spawning
Several new animations from our new animator Jonathan! 
SpeedTree and Quixel Foliage, Materials, and models added Audio implemented 
Landscapes now have more grass and are correctly painted, gaps are no longer visible in the landscape
Pistol has audio again 
Removed the constant breathing from the triceratops and stegosaurus by fixing the attenuation
Fixed the attenuation of all audio, menu music volume reduced, and audio is now no longer disorientating. However, volume level may still be an issue in-game, so please adjust it to a suitable level before playing.
Menu music replaced
Credits updated
Shotgun damage reduced
Edaphosaurus and Dimetrodon hitboxes fixed up
Bouncy of all animals altered to be around 0.35-1.01
Altered Menu background to be Ceratosaurus posed on pedastal
Redwood trees added to valley map
New trees added to Island map
Removed minimap cam from island map (Working on fixing the minimap to work on this map)
Resized the view distance for level streaming on the island map
Added footprints to T.Rex and Apatosaurus
Removed Triceratops temporarily from being able to spawn
Placed several animals on the island (Carcharodontosaurus, Allosaurus, Apatosaurus, T.Rex, Spinosaurus, Acrocanthosaurus, Ceratosaurus, Carnotaurus) due to the AI issue, the spawners have a reduced number to spawn. So we hope this can balance that
Tweaked several other setting for saving
Replaced materials on valley map
Added new grass
Add color grading 
Tweaked the white balance


About the download size

We are aware of the download size, and come 0.1.1.15 we will make sure to find methods to reduce the overall size. Currently, the project is at 21 GB at version 0.1.1.1, and the update itself being 8 GB. 

The frame drops on the -Omitted- Island map

There is frame drop on the island map. It is at an interval of roughly once a second. It does progressively get worse. This issue is due to a bug in our AI. We are currently removing our old AI and replacing it from scratch. This will come in a Hot-fix soon, and we really hope to squash it out once and for all since it has plagued us since the first alpha build that included the Island map.

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
We apologize for the delay, we were able to add a lot more than originally planned because of it; but some parts are still missing. We will be adding those as they are made in hot fixes. The current update 0.1.1.0 has been difficult to work on, but has breathed new life into the project as we have now added unlockables! That means we have moved from a sandbox where you can hunt a T.Rex from the get go, to a more creative game that requires the player to find creative ways to unlock many features. We will soon implement the hunt gallery where you can find all the hunts you have chosen to keep, and a better hint system; in part to the new unlock system.

New features:
- Updated First-person animations
- TR Shotgun, a power shotgun capable of hunting down even the largest of predators in only a few shots
- Valcon SMG, a quick way to deter any animal
- New crosshair
- Updated AI for Utah Raptor
- Updated AI for Dimetrodon
- Updated AI for Edaphosaurus & Compsognathus
- New unlockables! Hunt various dinosaurs to unlock more. Unlockables can be earned by hunting specific dinosaurs (Hints for these will be added in a later patch), or can be earned by gaining enough perma! 
- Controller keys and actions options
- Audio Control options
- Updated graphics options
- Added audio sensing to AI, try to hold your fire until you're capable of taking down your target
- Animation speeds updated
- Hunter run speed updated to 1,200
- Hunter walk speed updated to 500
- Hunter now can fire while running
- Weapons now apply a bit of a kickback, which raises the camera each time the weapon is fired:
TR Shotgun: 10 degrees
RP500: 5 degrees
Valcon SMG: 15 degrees
Pistol: 2 degrees
- Hunt calls have now been added, but temporarily disabled
- Herbivores now flee when frightened
- Herbivores now react with Carnivores, fleeing away when theyre near
- Carnivores now react with Herbivores, attacking their preferred diets
- In-Game UI overhauled
- UI configured to work with Steam (I.E. Main menu displays your correct Steam name and profile picture, displays your current friends and their online status, shows players who are in the same game/lobby)
- Added map images to multiplayer UI selection
- Fixed spawning in multiplayer
- Added Elasmosaurus, Parasaurlophus, Allosaurus, Carnotaurus, Majungasaurus and Carcharodontosaurus to Multiplayer

Bug fixes:
- Optimization
- Crosshair not fading when zooming in
- Better aligned animations for more accurate hunting
- Several AI bugs to be detailed later
- Slight changes to Multiplayer
- AI optimizations
- Ragdolls are now correctly implemented
- Hunt menu bugs (I.E. choices not carrying over, wrong map being ultimately chosen, prices being miscalculated)
- Fixed AI attack spheres

An audio update will come out soon that will add audio to each animal that has none or is missing any. We had to relieve Rolland as he had to move on and didn't have spare time for WOGD. We thankfully were able to have Matt come back on the team to help out for the time being. As such, this was one of the reasons for the large gap between the last update. The others being new techniques I learned, and revamping our old system for the animals. Which has helped us optimize the game better and allow it to run on more PC's. We want to thank you all for bearing with us, and we hope to see you at launch soon!

Please note that these may not be every change, more exact changes like AI values, and smaller fixes and updates are not noted. In future hot fixes and releases we will be able to note that

REMINDER This is the last update to contain multiplayer until further notice.
